run_pipeline_json: run the pipeline to generate valid JSON strings using a grammar-constrained HuggingFace text generation model
run_parse_args: run the argument parser to configure the model ID and device for JSON generation
run_main: run the main function to load a model, apply grammar constraints, and generate JSON output
review_IncrementalGrammarConstraint: review the IncrementalGrammarConstraint class used to enforce EBNF grammar rules on generated text
review_GrammarConstrainedLogitsProcessor: review the GrammarConstrainedLogitsProcessor that wraps grammar constraints for logits processing during generation
